gloss.en: The root قَلَعَ (qalaʿa) primarily means to pull, pluck, tear, or wrench something out or up, detaching it from its place. It signifies removal, displacement, or uprooting.
gloss.short: The root قَلَعَ (qalaʿa) primarily means to pull, pluck, tear, or wrench something out or up, detaching it from its place.
